Q1: How should this issue get routed to PR #7044's branch (`ai/issue-6769`)?
Choices:
A) Edit this issue's body so that `- Integration branch: ai/issue-6769` is on a line by itself, then post `/reclarify`. Planning and implementation then check out `ai/issue-6769` and run the investigation the issue asks for. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Run the investigation on the default branch: reproduce orchestrate-poll group 3, shard 0 there and fix it only if it fails there too. A fix on the default branch reaches PR #7044 only after that PR syncs with it.
C) Do no code work. Re-run the failing CI on PR #7044 and close this issue if the check passes.
